tools.name: get_top_stories
tools.description: Get tech story clusters from across the web. Each story aggregates coverage from multiple outlets (TechCrunch, The Verge, NYT, TechSnif, etc.) and includes links to social discussion (tweets, Reddit threads, LinkedIn posts). Sort by rank (prominence) or newest (most recently seen). Optionally filter by headline tier (1=standard, 2=major, 3=top story), publisher name, discussion platform, topic, or a "since" timestamp, and paginate with offset. Use get_story when you need full details or article body text.

limit.description: Number of stories to return (default 20, max 80)

sort.description: Sort order: "rank" (prominence, default) or "newest" (most recently seen)

publisher.description: Filter by lead publisher name (e.g. "TechCrunch", "The Verge", "TechSnif")

platform.description: Filter to stories discussed on this platform (e.g. "x", "bluesky", "threads", "linkedin", "forums", "mastodon")

has_discussion.description: Only return stories that have social discussion links

since.description: ISO 8601 date, only stories seen since this time (e.g. "2026-07-01")

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Get full details of a story cluster by slug, including all coverage links from every outlet (TechCrunch, NYT, TechSnif, etc.), direct URLs to social discussion posts (exact tweets, Reddit threads, LinkedIn posts, Bluesky posts), and the full TechSnif article text if available. Use this to answer "show me the tweets about this story" or "what outlets covered this". Filter discussion by platform, coverage by publisher, or use brief mode to skip the article body.

platform.description: Filter discussion links to this platform only (e.g. "x", "bluesky", "threads")

publisher.description: Filter coverage links by publisher name (e.g. "TechCrunch"). Does not affect the lead article or discussion links.

brief.description: Show metadata and links only, skip the full TechSnif article body

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Full-text search over story cluster headlines and excerpts, ranked by relevance. Returns matching story clusters with coverage links, discussion link counts, and TechSnif article references when available. Use get_story for full detail and article body text. Optionally filter by publisher and paginate with offset.

query.description: Search query, matches story headlines and excerpts (min 2 characters)

platform.description: Narrow displayed discussion links to this platform (e.g. "x", "bluesky")

tools.name: get_story_timeline
tools.description: Get the ranking history of a story cluster by slug: a time series of snapshots with rank, headline tier, commentary count, and coverage count at each point. Use this to see how a story rose, peaked, or faded across the news cycle.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Get story cluster changes since a timestamp: newly appeared clusters and updates to existing ones, each with a change type, a change time, and a story summary. Poll this to stay in sync with the TechSnif feed without refetching everything; pass the returned nextCursor as the next "since" value.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp to read changes from (defaults to 24 hours ago)

tools.name: get_trending_stories
tools.description: Get story clusters gaining momentum right now, ranked by velocity: how quickly coverage and discussion grew within a recent window. Each story includes its velocity score plus commentary and coverage deltas. Use get_story for full detail.

limit.description: Number of stories to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: get_tech_events
tools.description: Get upcoming tech industry events (conferences, summits, expos) with dates, locations, and URLs.

limit.description: Number of events to return (default 10, max 50)

tools.name: get_articles
tools.description: List TechSnif editorial articles (original coverage written by TechSnif). Filter by category (AI, Startups, Venture, Robotics) or tag, and paginate with offset. Use get_article for the full body text.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default 10, max 50)

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a full TechSnif editorial article by slug, including the complete body text.

brief.description: Show metadata and excerpt only, skip the full body

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search over TechSnif editorial article titles and excerpts, ranked by relevance. Returns article summaries with category, tags, and publish dates. Use get_article for the full body text, and paginate with offset.

query.description: Search query, matches article titles and excerpts (min 2 characters)

tools.name: get_trending_articles
tools.description: Get trending TechSnif editorial articles from the last 48 hours, ranked by coverage heat and recency. Use get_article for the full body text.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default 5, max 20)

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get TechSnif source or author leaderboards: which publications and journalists drive the most tech story coverage. Rank by story count over a 7-day, 30-day, or all-time window, optionally filtered by topic.

limit.description: Number of entries to return (default 50, max 100)
